Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 365)

Changes since build 360.

Restore

  • After an update or Force Quit, Claude tabs resume even when macOS gave the old process ID to another program.
  • A Claude chat that was never saved now starts fresh, instead of "No conversation found".
  • The restore message names the tabs it could not resume.
  • Restart Agent says when it starts a new conversation.
  • The tab keeps its name while Claude starts again.

Settings

  • settings.json now holds only the settings you changed. A new file is {}. Delete a key to get its default.
  • Your old settings file is cleaned once: values equal to the default are removed. Keys you write later stay.
  • Every setting is now in the Settings window, in settings.json and in Cmd+P, with clear names.
  • Quick terminal shortcut, height and auto-hide are in settings.json.
  • Removed 9 settings that no longer did anything.

Quick AI

  • Every Claude and Codex account (for example ~/.claude and ~/.claude-b) is found. When there is more than one, the account label in the footer is a dropdown, and the chat, / commands and skills use the chosen account.
  • Cursor stays in the Provider menu when its login check is slow or unclear; only a clear logout or a missing CLI hides it.
  • The account name in the footer uses the normal text colour.

Toolbar

  • Cmd-drag on the Pull Requests, Actions, Music and Quick AI icons reorders them instead of moving the whole window.
  • The dragged icon follows the pointer without jumping left and right.

Window

  • The main window reopens on the same monitor, in the same place and size, after an update or relaunch.
  • If that monitor is gone, or the window would be partly off screen, it opens fully on a screen.
  • The first launch after installing this build still uses the old placement; from then on the place is kept.

Other

  • Claude no longer shows "hook timed out after 2s" in normal use: the activity hook is much faster, no longer leaves a stuck lock, and waits up to 10 seconds.
  • Tabs: a busy tab says Running instead of Working.
  • Browser: auto page darkening no longer inverts an empty app shell on script-drawn sites and then undoes it a moment later.

Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 360)

  • Music Player (new): a toolbar button appears when a YouTube Music tab is open. The card shows the song, artwork, time bar and play/pause, next, previous and ±10 s buttons, and every button animates when pressed. Songs slide in from the right on next and from the left on previous.
  • Music Player: Cmd-P has Play / Pause music, Next track, Previous track, Forward 10 seconds and Back 10 seconds.
  • Music Player: starting music in one YouTube Music tab pauses the others, and the card follows the tab you started. Turn it off in Settings > Music Player > Pause other music tabs.
  • Music Player: a notification with the cover art appears when the song changes. It is on by default and needs Notifications on; turn it off in Settings > Music Player.
  • Extensions menu: one compact line per extension; descriptions are in the tooltip.
  • Toolbar: hold Cmd and drag the PR, Actions, Music and Quick AI icons to reorder them. Esc or a drop outside cancels. Cmd-P > Reset Toolbar Extension Order restores the default.
  • Esc closes the open toolbar panel (Music Player, Pull Requests, Extensions, Notifications), even when the terminal has focus.
  • Tabs: dragging a tab over another tab sorts it. The split highlight shows only after a short hold over the other tab's middle.
  • Split groups in the compact tab rail can be dragged to any position, and slide aside when a tab is dragged past them.
  • Icons: choose a colour for custom tab and workspace icons in the icon picker, from 8 distinct colours (white stays the default), or use the Multicolor swatch to pick any colour. The colour shows in tabs, hover previews, notifications, closed-tab history and menus, and survives a restart. Emoji icons keep their own colours.
  • Terminals: a tab from before the zmx 1.0.1 update that stayed hidden (for example in Quick terminal) now ends its own old session and resumes its agent. Tabs that already lost their link in builds 347-355 still need their old session ended in Task Manager.
  • An alert now shows once, in the active window, instead of in both the main window and Quick terminal.
  • System Health and AI usage hover cards no longer show a dark rectangular frame around them.
